edit_contract.open_project_adoption_choices: OpenProject adopts the complete staged archive preserving ProjectId and saved revision. Empty objects_to_create/module_versions/selected_assets mean no filtering; each nonempty list must equal the corresponding full task proposal or full asset list without duplicates. Subsets, additions and remapping are unsupported. Manifest missing or blocking project Issues require accept_missing_as_draft=true; invalid required files/references remain import failure.
edit_contract.scenario_document_revision: ScenarioInput.revision/project_revision are Host-owned structural metadata in Project transactions. New Put payload revision=1; existing Put payload revision=current Scenario revision; project_revision=base_revision. Successful Project commit binds current scenarios to new Project revision and changed inputs receive a fresh session per-ID high-water revision, never refunded by undo/delete. SubjectRevisionId remains explicit business input; exact old references are not auto-upgraded. On open, initialize each ID high-water from all actually included and identity/revision-validated Scenario documents, including retained FrozenRunScenario/SupportingFile roles; absent optional declarations are excluded and old contents are never reactivated.
edit_contract.initial_material_draft_policy: Initial stock, future arrivals, supply targets, demand, soft plans, hard-reservation declarations and unique holders remain separate typed inputs. Semantic gaps stay as located business_inputs material Issues blocking Execution/CompleteConclusion; no runtime stock/splits are created by edits. A future run Host must reject known Execution blockers before Worker initialization; run_scenario remains unavailable in this slice.
